details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:711-729 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The OpenCode external_directory grant uses the exact file path "/support/static-context/agents.rendered.md" as its key, but OpenCode matches the parent-directory glob `path.join(dirname(target), "*")` ("/support/static-context/*"); the grant never matches, so the read falls through to "ask", which `opencode run` rejects.
  WHY: OpenCode-path roles (JUDGE_INTERIM always; the editor, consolidator, RB judge and behavioural smoke on Claude fallback with exit 75) get an index-only prompt that points at a file they cannot read, and test_sandbox_mounts_regular_rendered_file_read_only only checks the JSON shape; all three reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high).
- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:663-685 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The external_directory grant key is the exact file path, but OpenCode's assertExternalDirectory checks `path.join(dirname(target), "*") = "/support/static-context/*"`, so the request does not match and the read falls through to "ask", which `opencode run` rejects.
  WHY: OpenCode-path roles cannot read the rendered file and get neither the full agents.md nor the rendered index; rated BLOCKER (mapped to critical). Same root cause as the 711-729 entry, but the cited line range does not overlap it, so the two are kept separate.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2781-2783 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In review_static_agents_try_index, a STATIC_CONTEXT_AGENTS_MODE value that is neither "index" nor "inline" (for example "indx" or "index ") is treated as an explicit inline with reason=mode_inline, and no ::warning:: is emitted.
  WHY: README.md:230 (and agents.md:2857) say "any other value inlines with a warning". A typo silently brings back the ~833 KB prefix on every review run, and the log cannot be told apart from a deliberate rollback; all reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low).
- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:628-630, 795-797, 453-475 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: When the in-sandbox readability check fails, the code only logs `REVIEW_SANDBOX_STATIC_CONTEXT agents=unreadable`, and the absent and refused branches skip the mount, yet the model still runs with the index-only ./pre_assembled_static.txt.
  WHY: The workflow decided index or inline earlier, on the host, so a role whose mount is skipped or unreadable gets a prompt pointing at a file it cannot read and has no inline fallback; rated MAJOR (mapped to high).
- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:473 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The "symbolic link or not a regular file" warning fires both for symlinks and for comma or newline characters in the real path, which hides the actual cause.
  WHY: A generic, misleading warning makes troubleshooting hard; rated NIT (mapped to low).
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:1144-1163 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In index mode, when reviewer_static_context.txt is missing, empty or not a regular file, panel reviewers fall back to ./pre_assembled_static.txt, which points them at /support/static-context/agents.rendered.md, a path PANEL_REVIEWER is never granted (no mount and no external_directory entry).
  WHY: A fallback panel reviewer that follows the pointer cannot read the file, so quality degrades in a rare fallback path (no crash); rated NIT (mapped to low).
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml / PR head test state (PR description "Pre-push test gate"):gate section of the PR body | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The gate reports "failures caused by this change: 7", but every named test file is outside the diff, and test_gitattributes_carries_the_union_backstop cannot fail on this checkout (.gitattributes:2 has the backstop), so the gate ran against a different tree state (merge commit 8f7141e).
  WHY: If any of the other six failures still reproduces on the current head, the PR cannot merge green, and the recorded gate state does not establish the real cause; rated MAJOR (mapped to high).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Before using index mode for a role, confirm it can read that path: a preflight `test -r` inside the sandbox, or the OpenCode config grant. Otherwise fall back to `inline` for that run and log why." (Issue #8954, Approach step 3)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (index-vs-inline decision) and scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh (per-role readability handling / inline prefix selection)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The workflow decides once per run from a host-side check (`[ ! -r "${review_static_agents_rendered}" ]`; cited as ~line 2840 by two reviewers and as lines 2818-2822 by one), scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:628-630 (Claude path) and 795-797 (OpenCode path) only log `REVIEW_SANDBOX_STATIC_CONTEXT agents=unreadable` and then invoke the model with the index-only prompt, lines 453-475 skip the mount when the file is absent or refused but leave the prompt index-only, no code path rebuilds ./pre_assembled_static.txt in inline mode, and the OpenCode path relies on a grant whose key probably does not match OpenCode's request instead of keeping inline (so JUDGE_INTERIM gets neither a working grant nor an inline fallback).
- requirement: Add the changelog fragment "with the measured before/after prefix bytes from a real run."
  expected_change_site: changelog.d/8954-review-agents-index.md
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The fragment says the byte counts were "Measured locally with this repository's files"; it gives no measurements from a real review run.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:lines 711-729, the OpenCode config rewrite for issue #8954: `static_agents_path = "/support/static-context/agents.rendered.md"`, then `existing[static_agents_path] = "allow"` or `permission["external_directory"] = {static_agents_path: "allow"}` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The grant is keyed on the exact file path, but OpenCode matches the parent-directory glob "/support/static-context/*" against the rule keys, so the request falls back to "ask", which `opencode run` rejects; write_opencode_config.sh:153-167 gives the reviewer role no other external_directory rule (caveat: the reviewer could not check OpenCode's source or the effect of `--auto`).
  WHY: JUDGE_INTERIM (always OpenCode, read access), the consolidator, the RB judge and read roles that fall back with exit 75 cannot read the rendered file, and in index mode they have no inline text either; the test only checks the JSON shape. Suggested fix: also grant "/support/static-context/*".
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:step "Pre-assemble static context (cacheable across runs)", review_static_agents_try_index mode_inline branch; README.md row `STATIC_CONTEXT_AGENTS_MODE` (line ~230) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: An unrecognised mode value (for example "indx" or "index ") is treated as an explicit inline, with reason=mode_inline and no ::warning::, contrary to the README.
  WHY: A typo silently brings back the ~833 KB prefix, and the log looks the same as a deliberate rollback.
- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:lines 628-630 (Claude container) and 795-797 (OpenCode container); also lines 453-475 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A failed in-sandbox readability check only logs `agents=unreadable`, and the absent and refused branches skip the mount; the model still runs with the index-only ./pre_assembled_static.txt.
  WHY: The workflow's decision was made on the host, so roles whose mount is skipped or unreadable (for example when RUNTIME_DIR is not exported) get no inline fallback, which the issue requires.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (3 related items), HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3: add a "/support/static-context/*" grant at lines 714-729; warn and set reason=mode_invalid for unknown mode values; give a distinct refusal reason in the line 473 warning.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Before using index mode for a role, confirm it can read that path: a preflight `test -r` inside the sandbox, or the OpenCode config grant. Otherwise fall back to `inline` for that run and log why." (Issue #8954, Approach step 3), plus the Constraints text on the OpenCode fallback keeping `inline`.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml decision step and/or scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh per-role handling.
  Evidence of absence: The run makes one host-side decision, lines 628-630 and 795-797 only log, lines 453-475 skip the mount without changing the prompt, and the OpenCode path relies on a grant that probably does not match.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
